**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744),
[Miss Gaye](../persons.html#552) wants to have her M S back that she may know what to do with it.
I believe you know [Miss Cheape](../persons.html#289)’s address, if she is not at St Andrews, would you get a proof of Christian sent to her - I sent up two chapters, but I think I can only put one in.
[Miss Tanner](../persons.html#1395). I think you had better send to the care of
[Mrs Sidney Lear](../persons.html#859)
the Close Salisbury
I do not know who wrote Tokens -
I suppose I told you that the Grey Woman, in the Christmas number is by Miss Benson the [Archbishop](../persons.html#140)’s daughter[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: ‘The Grey Woman’ is a harrowing tale signed ‘A.E.D.’, which appeared in the MP Christmas number (1889).

Two letters in the Bodleian Library to [Margaret Benson](../persons.html#1858) suggest she was a contributor, though neither seems to refer to this story directly.
